# PR #4376: Patch: follow-up to #4360 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #4374

Changed `drive()` in [crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-4374/crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs) so every illegal probe is asserted refused at the point it fires. Each loop iteration now binds the probe and calls `run_reduce(&state, content, &probe).expect_err(...)` with a message naming the probe and the phase. The `refusals` counter, the `before` clone, the never-failing clone-equality assert, the `Ok` acceptance arm, and the trailing aggregate assert are all gone. Module and `drive()` doc comments were updated to match. No production code, config, spec, or ruling change.

How I tested it (commands I ran, what they printed):

- `cargo test -p jackioh-run map_fuzz_random_policy_with_illegal_probes_stays_in_bounds_and_replays` — 1 passed, 0 failed.
- Mutant negative check: temporarily changed the relic-wait `OpenPack` arm in `crates/run/src/lib.rs` to open the pack — the fast test went red with `mapfuzz placeholder 1: illegal OpenPack { index: 0 } accepted at Reward { artifact: Some(...) ... }`. Reverted `lib.rs`; `git status --porcelain` shows only `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs` modified.
- `cargo fmt --check` — clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` — clean, no new allows.

Decisions: the plan's literal `expect_err(format!(...))` does not compile (`expect_err` takes `&str`, and `rustc E0308` said so on the first run), so I used `expect_err(&format!(...))` — same message naming the probe and phase, same assertion. I also touched up the two stale doc comments in the same file rather than leaving them describing the old accept/clone-equal behavior; `check_run_invariants` is still used by the walk-step checks below, so its import stays.

Reviewer notes: the new `expect_err` message embeds the full `RunState` debug dump on failure (inherited from `expect_err` printing the `Ok` value), which makes the red output very long but self-diagnosing; worth checking the diff hunk at lines ~114-134 of the test file.

# #4374: Patch: follow-up to #4360 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4360 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4360 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44851939720)) found 2 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`f1ddc391cf2b`). `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4360 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs:136`: The fuzz driver never checks that an illegal probe is refused. When `run_reduce` accepts a probe, the `Ok(next)` arm only runs `check_run_invariants`, and the only refusal check is `refusals > 0` across the whole run, so any single refusal can break and the test stays green.
  Evidence: I checked each probe against `apply` in crates/run/src/lib.rs:1871-2145 and every one is always refused: an off-path or out-of-range `Go` (1887-1891), `Leave` in a fight (catch-all at 2143), `OpenPack` while a relic waits (1948), `TakeArtifact` with no relic (catch-all), `Keep` of a card outside the pack (1971-1976), extraction, buy, removal and leveling past the end (1990, 2000, 2012, 2040, 2060), `RemoveCards [0]` where RUN_CAMPFIRE_REMOVE is 2 (2084), `Choose`/`Bless` past the end (2103, 2137). So `illegal_action`'s doc comment ('One action the phase must refuse') is right, but `drive` treats acceptance as fine. Example of a bug it misses: change the `(Reward{artifact: Some(_)}, OpenPack)` arm at 1942-1949 to open the pack and drop the relic. The OpenPack probe is then accepted, the invariants still hold, Map probes are still refused, so `refusals > 0` passes and the test stays green. A new catch-all `(_, Leave) => Map` arm (the 'future screen' bug #4247 names) would also pass. The issue asks to 'Assert every refusal returns `Err`'. Fix: replace the match with `run_reduce(..).expect_err(..)` naming the phase and the probe, then drop the unreachable `Ok` arm and the `refusals` counter.
- [ ] `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs:138`: `assert_eq!(state, before, "a refusal changed the state")` can never fail, so the acceptance item 'a refused illegal action mutating the state (checked by clone equality)' has no test.
  Evidence: `run_reduce(state: &RunState, ..)` (lib.rs:1568) takes a shared reference, and RunState has no interior mutability (grep for Cell/RefCell/Mutex in crates/run/src/lib.rs finds nothing). The compiler guarantees `state == before`. The PR's mutant for this item ('Ok-on-Err run_reduce') was caught only by `refusals > 0`, not by this assert. Under this API, 'a refusal mutates the state' can only mean a refusal returned as `Ok` with a partly changed clone. The expect_err in the finding above catches that, so this assert should be removed or replaced by it, not kept as a check that cannot fail.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

    Err(_) => {
        assert_eq!(state, before, "mapfuzz {tag} {n}: a refusal changed the state");
        refusals += 1;
    }

Run `cargo test -p jackioh-run map_fuzz_random_policy_with_illegal_probes_stays_in_bounds_and_replays`.
- Purity/clippy gate for the touched crate: `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` (must be clean; no new `#[allow(...)]`).
- Format gate: `cargo fmt --check`.
- Do not run the ignored `map_fuzz_daily_wide_sweep`, whole-workspace suites, or fuzz gates; CI covers those.

## Done when

- [ ] Every illegal probe in `drive()` is asserted with `expect_err` naming the phase and the probe; the `Ok` acceptance arm is gone.
- [ ] The `refusals` counter, the `before` clone, the `assert_eq!(state, before, ...)` and the trailing `assert!(refusals > 0, ...)` are all gone.
- [ ] The issue's example mutant (relic-wait `OpenPack` accepted) turns the fast fuzz test red; reverted afterwards.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-run map_fuzz_random_policy_with_illegal_probes_stays_in_bounds_and_replays`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` are green with no skipped, ignored, weakened, or deleted test.
- [ ] Only `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs` is modified.

- Unused-variable/import breakage: removing `before` and `refusals` while leaving a use behind fails the build. The plan deletes all four related lines together; `check_run_invariants` must keep its import because the walk-step checks below still call it.
- Determinism: unchanged — seeds, `fuzz_setup`, walk policy, and fold-back checks are untouched; only the probe assertion changes.
- No replay, hidden-information, or contract risk: no production code, config constant, or public signature changes.

## Open questions

None.
